model_output:
```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Pittsburg' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
)
SELECT
  MAX(elev) - MIN(elev) AS vertical_range
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_ValueCount(r.rast, r.geom)).*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, 1, geom, TRUE) AS rast
    FROM
      region_geom,
      public.dem_us
    WHERE
      ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast::geometry, geom)
  ) AS r,
  region_geom
) AS elev_counts;
```
